title: Ñaawoore Yiite Ceniinde
intro: E nder leydi ɓooyndi ndi dewal kaaƴe cewɗe ƴettiti e nder galle kala, neɗɗo gooto ina darii heen. E nder hoolaare nde ustataako e ndeenka Alla, ɓe njokkondiri e ko fotnoo wonde maayde laaɓtunde — ɓe njahi ɓe ngalaa ko boni. Mbele aɗa waawi udditaade sifaa ooɗoo ruuhu kaawningol?
clues: Mi ummiima e yimɓe sujjuɓe e sanamuuji ɗi ɓe mbayli e juuɗe maɓɓe, ina cikka ɗeen geɗe ina njogii doole Alla.
Nde luulndiimi ko ɓe ngoongɗini koo, ɓe ndartini mi e fuɗɗoode, kono mi waawaa deƴƴude e goonga mo nganndu mi oo.
Ñalnde ɓe kawri, mi halki sanamuuji maɓɓe, mi acci tan ɓurɗo mawnude oo, mi memi ɗum.
Nde ɓe ngarti, ɓe nji’i ko mbaɗmi koo, ardiiɓe maɓɓe njamiri yo ƴulɓe mawɗe mbaɗe, ina njiɗi werlaade mi e nder yiite.
Ɓe mberlii kam e nder yiite ɓuuɓnge, kono Joomiraawo adunaaji ɗii yamiri yo ɗum wontu cooyɗo e kisal wonande am.
Mi yaltii e lewlewndu nduu mi alaa ko bonnata mi, tawi waɗnooɓe mi ɓee ina njogori bonnude no feewi.

outcome.label: Keeɓal
options: Alla waɗi jeynge ngee cooyni, kisal
Laana kaa jippii e jam e dow haayre
Sanam kaŋŋe oo ɓuuɓtii yeeso gite maɓɓe
Tiranoowo gooto e konu mum njippiima e maayo
outcome.answer: Alla waɗi jeynge ngee cooyni, kisal

arabic: قَالُوا۟ حَرِّقُوهُ وَٱنصُرُوٓا۟ ءَالِهَتَكُمْ إِن كُنتُمْ فَـٰعِلِينَ
verse: They said, "Burn him and support your gods - if you are to act." (21:68)
